answer: Work-slot deposit burn ends the fable of free identities. At dawn each agent burns a 25-unit deposit to anchor one work slot to itself; the slot opens only to its owner. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 25 = 2,500 units for a 30-unit epoch reward, and burned funds cannot be reused. An honest agent pays 25 once, keeps the slot for 20 epochs and earns fees, so one real identity is cheap while a fake army is ruinous.
